quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 34

questions.question: When driving in traffic, what is the safest thing to do?

options.text: Change your speed often to stay alert.
Drive at the same speed as other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive at the same speed as other cars.
questions.explanation: Crashes happen when drivers go faster or slower than other vehicles. Always drive at the same speed as other traffic. Stay within the posted speed limit.

questions.question: Lanes moving in the same direction are separated by ____ lines.
questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going in the same direction. Broken white lines can be crossed to pass. Yellow lines separate lanes going in opposite directions.

questions.question: When can you safely continue through a yellow light?

options.text: When an emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow, you should continue through carefully.

questions.question: Where should you keep a space cushion around your vehicle?

options.text: Only on the left and right sides.
Only in front of your vehicle.
On all sides of your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: On all sides of your vehicle.
questions.explanation: Keep space around all sides of your vehicle so you have time to react to hazards. Do not drive too close to vehicles on your left or right.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead.
It directs you to cities and towns.
It tells you about traffic laws.
It tells you about road construction.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road or traffic conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs with black symbols on a yellow background are warning signs. They tell you about conditions on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does a green arrow traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is used only on one-way streets.
It means go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow shows.
It only works if a circular green light is also showing.
It points the way to an airport.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means go, but you must turn in the direction the arrow shows.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go, but you must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?

options.text: Do not speed when roads are wet.
Keep tires filled to the correct air pressure.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when your tires slide on water between the tire and the road. Low tire pressure and worn tires increase hydroplaning risk. Speeding also makes hydroplaning more likely.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: A flashing yellow light will appear.
A steady green light will appear.
A steady red light will appear.
A flashing red light will appear.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steady red light will appear.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will appear soon.

questions.question: When can you cross a dashed white line?

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate lanes going in the same direction. You can cross them to pass when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when crossing a railroad track with no signals or gates?

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You can pass slower cars while crossing.
Make sure your vehicle can cross the tracks without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle can cross the tracks without stopping.
questions.explanation: Check that you have enough space to cross the tracks without stopping. Never pass other vehicles at a railroad crossing. Always check for trains before crossing.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns green, what should you do?

options.text: Speed up as fast as you can.
Wait for another driver to wave you on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let pedestrians cross first.
questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. But first, you must let pedestrians and other traffic finish crossing the intersection.

questions.question: At dusk or on cloudy days, you should:

options.text: Drive with your hazard lights on.
Drive with your parking lights on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your headlights.
questions.explanation: Turn on your headlights at dusk and on cloudy days. Use low beams when you are within 1,000 feet of an oncoming car and within 500 feet of a car you are following. Always use low beams in bad weather.

questions.question: If two drivers reach a four-way stop sign at the same time, who goes first?

options.text: One driver may go without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver on the right.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, if you arrive at the same time as another driver, let the driver on your right go first. Then you can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When are roads most slippery?

options.text: After it has rained for an hour or more.
In the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: In the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are very slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. Rain brings oil from the asphalt to the surface. Hot weather makes this worse because heat and water bring more oil to the road.

questions.question: Mixing alcohol with drugs can:
questions.correctAnswerText: Make both effects stronger.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol and drugs can make the effects of both much stronger. Driving after using either one is dangerous. Driving after using both is even more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Deer crossing.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When turning left, you must yield to:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: When turning left, yield to oncoming traffic. Always yield to pedestrians, cyclists, and other cars already in the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you there is not much clearance above the road ahead.

questions.question: What helps drivers avoid crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add extra weight to get better grip.
Leave the highway as soon as possible.
Slow down and stay farther behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stay farther behind other cars.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snow and ice. This and increasing your distance from other cars are the best ways to avoid crashes in these conditions.

questions.question: Orange signs are used for:
questions.correctAnswerText: Work zones.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are diamond-shaped, orange with black letters, and warn that workers are on or near the road.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance ramp, you should generally:

options.text: Drive faster than traffic to get ahead.
Enter slowly to avoid other vehicles.
Stop first, then slowly enter traffic.
Speed up to match the traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Highway entrance ramps have acceleration lanes. Signal, look for an opening, speed up to match traffic, and merge safely.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.correctAnswerText: Shaded.
questions.explanation: Shaded areas freeze faster than sunny areas. They also take longer to dry. Be extra careful on roads shaded by trees or buildings in cold, wet weather.

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the shoulder with no children inside.
When it approaches you, even if its lights are not flashing.
On a two-lane highway when its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a two-lane highway when its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when a school bus shows flashing red lights while picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic in both directions must stop. The stop arm may also be extended.

questions.question: You may drive around the gates at a railroad crossing:

options.text: When the lights have stopped flashing.
When other drivers drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: Always stop at railroad crossings when warning signs appear. Do not go around lowered gates. Warning signs include flashing red lights, lowered gates, a flagger, or a train's whistle.

questions.question: Downward-facing triangular signs tell drivers to:
questions.correctAnswerText: Yield the right of way.
questions.explanation: Downward-facing triangular signs mean yield. Slow down and let other traffic pass. You may go when it is safe and the road is clear.

questions.question: Taking drugs along with alcohol:

options.text: Is no more dangerous than alcohol alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increases the risk of crashing.
questions.explanation: Drugs (illegal, prescription, or over-the-counter) can affect your brain and impair driving. Mixing drugs with alcohol greatly increases crash risk.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights, you must:

options.text: Slow down and stay in your lane.
Pull to the right and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When you see flashing lights or hear a siren on an emergency vehicle, pull to the right side of the road and stop immediately.

questions.question: Drowsy drivers:

options.text: Should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
Can drive so poorly that they look drunk.
Can stay alert by opening a window and turning up the radio.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can drive so poorly that they look drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can seem as impaired as drunk drivers. Opening windows, turning up the radio, or drinking coffee is not enough. A drowsy driver needs rest.

questions.question: Road rage and aggressive driving can be reduced by:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: To prevent road rage: use turn signals, obey speed limits, and allow plenty of time to reach your destination.

questions.question: When approaching a railroad crossing warning sign, you should:

options.text: Try to drive faster than the train.
Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Look for a way around any lowered gates.
Assume no trains are coming and drive normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: Railroad warning signs alert you that a train may be near. Obey all warning signs. Never go around barriers or ignore the warning.

questions.question: A driver entering public traffic from a driveway or private road should do what?

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
Assume other drivers will change lanes to make room.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
questions.explanation: When entering traffic from a driveway or private road, you must yield to drivers already on the public road. Merge safely when it is possible.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Pass a slow vehicle if you can do it quickly.
Pass if you know the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must follow the rules on all regulatory signs. Where this sign is posted, you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What do speed limit signs tell you?

options.text: The highest or lowest speed allowed by law.
The speed to drive in heavy traffic.
The speed to drive in bad conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest or lowest speed allowed by law.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the highest or lowest safe speed allowed on a road. The maximum limit is for ideal conditions. You must slow down when conditions require it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: School crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, what should you do?

options.text: Drive through if there is no crossing traffic.
Keep driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights are used at dangerous intersections. Treat them the same as stop signs.

questions.question: When can you not cross a single broken white or yellow line?

options.text: When it would interfere with traffic.
When turning left into a driveway.
When the car ahead is broken down.
When passing to the right on a one-way street.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it would interfere with traffic.
questions.explanation: You can cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes if you can do it safely and without interfering with other traffic.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign warn you about?

options.text: Hazards that exist or might happen.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hazards that exist or might happen.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards on the road. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What kind of sign is always octagonal?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop sign.
questions.explanation: All octagonal signs are stop signs. Come to a full stop when you see a red eight-sided sign.

questions.question: If you are in another driver's blind spot, what should you do?

options.text: Move forward or drop back so they can see you.
Keep driving at the same speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move forward or drop back so they can see you.
questions.explanation: Do not stay in another driver's blind spot. Move ahead or slow down so the other driver can see you.

questions.question: When you approach a steady red traffic light, what must you do?

options.text: Drive through if there is no crossing traffic.
Keep driving because you have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely.
questions.explanation: A steady red light means you must stop completely. Running a red light is illegal and dangerous. You may turn right on red if there is no sign that forbids it.
